name: Camera Shutter Dump
summary: Stack twelve photos into a collage on black, one per camera shutter sound, as editable Image clips with bundled shutter effects.

compatibility.selects: Requires a Selects build with original Image editing, editable effects/graphics and Audio source-window verification. This version's installed-app and Windows runtime, full playback and export checks remain pending.
